results.title: The Spirit of Halloween
results.overview: Brilliant bridal designer Everly Stone has no patience for Halloween, especially the beloved fire-station bash that once left her heartbroken in front of everyone she knew, but when her late mentor appears with a glamorous warning, Everly Stone is swept through one unforgettable night by three mischievous spirits who reveal the joy she lost, the people she’s pushing away, and the future she might miss if she keeps hiding behind work and fear. With a loyal assistant ready for more, a town waiting to welcome her back, and longtime friend Beau Madison still carrying a spark from their past, Everly Stone must decide whether Halloween is the night that broke her heart or the one that can finally help it heal.

results.title: The Cull
results.overview: Wrongly imprisoned for his mother’s murder, Niall is finally released, having found God and renounced a life of violence and addiction. Retreating to a remote woodland cabin seeking redemption and the truth behind her death, he finds a hostile community ruled by a ruthless family, where every encounter deepens the mystery surrounding his mother’s past. As brutal violence erupts and terrifying visions blur the line between nightmare and reality, Niall uncovers a sinister legacy of witchcraft, blood sacrifice and forbidden ritual. Something has been patiently waiting in the forest, and its hunger for vengeance can only be satisfied with blood.

results.title: Truck Driver
results.overview: A hybrid film that paints a collective portrait of people who share a strange dimension of time within the silence of the asphalt wilderness – at motels, on the side of the road, and in tire shops, savoring the pure joy of the present moment while longing for loved ones far away.

results.title: On The Edge
results.overview: The main character of our film is Ilyas Sharbuzov, an intensivist from Dagestan, and his family. Ilyas is a perfectionist, and if an emergency occurs, he always tries to be at the epicenter to help. Ilyas's wife, Aminat, worked in the intensive care unit, so she tries to be understanding of her husband's work. His young daughters have also become accustomed to their father's work schedule. But everything changes for Ilyas and his family when he is sent on a mission to a military hospital in a war zone.

results.title: Beyond Boy
results.overview: After his ship lands on Earth, an unsuspecting farmer and his wife raise a young alien boy as one of their own.

results.title: Halina Ni Aliya
results.overview: Get an exclusive look at VMX star Aliya Raymundo’s irresistible charm and the roles that made her shine. Don’t miss these sizzling sneak peeks that will turn up the heat and make your summer even hotter.

results.title: Cold War 1994
results.overview: In 1994, a tycoon's kidnapping shook Hong Kong, threatening its financial standing. Police pursued personal gain while OCID Superintendent Li Wenbin risked everything to navigate conflicting interests and expose the truth.

results.title: Queen of Chess
results.overview: A Hungarian girl dreams of conquering international men’s chess. After a 15-year battle against world champion Garry Kasparov and her domineering father, Judit Polgár revolutionizes the sport’s patriarchal culture to become one of the greatest chess prodigies in history and the greatest woman chess player of all time.

results.title: Krishnavataram Part 1: The Heart (Hridayam)
results.overview: An epic devotional narrative that reimagines the journey of Lord Krishna, tracing his path from Dwarka to Kurukshetra after parting ways with Radha. As his journey unfolds, it explores his connection with people, his layered personality, and the lessons he imparts about love and life.

results.title: WWE SummerSlam 2026: Sunday
results.overview: The 2026 SummerSlam, also promoted as SummerSlam: Minnesota, is a professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) and livestreaming event produced by WWE. It is the 39th annual SummerSlam and took place as a two-night event on August 1st and 2nd at U.S. Bank Stadium in Minneapolis, Minnesota.

results.title: #Vymara
results.overview: Four washed-up creators livestream their search for a missing YouTuber linked to a conspiracy and uncover a sinister truth never meant to go viral.

results.title: The Spoon
results.overview: A young Taiwanese woman Kai spends a summer day with German relatives at an allotment. At lunch they make a surprising discovery: one of the spoons has a swastika engraved on it. In the ensuing discussion different ideas come up about what to do with the artefact.

results.title: Descendants/ZOMBIES Worlds Collide: Concert Special
results.overview: Celebrating the high-energy music from the iconic Descendants and ZOMBIES franchises, the Descendants/ZOMBIES Worlds Collide Tour thrilled sold-out crowds in over 40 arenas across North America last summer. Now, families and fans of all ages can relive the excitement - singing and dancing along with their favorite stars from the comfort of home.

results.title: A Second Chance Christmas
results.overview: Anna and James Campbell have been divorced for five years, their once-happy union now a carefully managed truce for the sake of their children. When their daughter invites the entire family to meet her serious boyfriend over Christmas at her grandparents’ rustic Smoky Mountain cabin, the former couple reluctantly agrees. Arriving a day early to avoid awkwardness, Anna is surprised to find James has the same idea. But when the worst ice storm in a decade traps them in the mountains with no way out, the exes are forced to confront the history they share – and the possibility that their story may not be finished after all.

results.title: The Journey to Gyeong-ju
results.overview: Eight years ago, the youngest daughter, Gyeong-ju, disappeared during a school field trip to Gyeongju and never came home alive.  On what would have been her birthday, her mother Ok-sil and her three daughters—Jang-ju, Young-ju, and Dong-ju—put on matching family T-shirts and set off for Gyeongju, the place where Gyeong-ju vanished, in what appears to be a family trip to honor her memory. But beneath the cheerful façade lies a deadly secret. In the trunk of their van is a bound and unconscious man zipped inside a plastic bag.

results.title: Patricio Bisso
results.overview: Patricio Bisso was an Argentine multidisciplinary artist who rose to stardom in Brazilian theatre and television, where he developed a meteoric career marked by his irreverent and highly individualistic personality.

results.title: Dastaar
results.overview: A Sikh immigrant rises from newcomer to community leader following a devastating racist attack.

results.title: The Great Punjab Robbery
results.overview: Three robbers with strange names seize an ordinary bank in Punjab. No demands. No ransom. Just cryptic riddles sent to the cops, each one leading deeper into the mystery.
